text:
alex: Heads-up — we need a quick decision: do we ship the bugfix-only patch for the post-launch crash (high-severity, 3 customers hit) in today’s micro-release, or push it to next week and include the UX polish?

maria: Can we get numbers? how bad is the crash in % of requests? :thinking_face:

alex: @maria — crash is ~0.6% of requests overall, spikes to ~2.1% on a specific customer dataset. Repro steps in the ticket. Customer A filed a support P1.

jeff: I ran the repro locally. Root cause is a race in KV cache eviction. I have a fix ready, small patch: `kv_cache:guard -> atomic swap` change. Should be a 1hr code + 30m QA if nothing else pops up.

sara: If it's 1.5 hours total, do we have a deployment window? we’re mid-canary for the analytics route. Any chance of regression on embeddings path?

jeff: I added unit tests for embeddings path. Also ran a quick perf pass — no reg. but want to run canary for 2 hours.

toni: We should weigh customer SLA vs churn risk. If Customer A is on a paid Dedicated plan, escalate to immediate ship. If self-serve, maybe wait and bundle with the UX polish (less churn impact).

alex: Customer A is on Dedicated and has an open escalation. I'd prefer patch-only to avoid prolonging outage.

maria: +1 patch-only. We can plan the UX polish for next week’s minor release.

jeff: I'll open a PR now with `WIP: kv-fix` and link the ticket.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary start 4123456802, full rollout window 4123456822. Operator: @sara.

sara: I’ll watch canary metrics and rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for 5m. Also will run the embeddings smoke.

alex: Action items: (1) @jeff open PR + include test case, (2) @sara manage canary and verify embeddings/latency, (3) @maria update CS playbook and tell Customer A we're shipping an urgent patch today. Plan follow-up UX polish in next sprint.

maria: I'll coordinate with CS and set expectation window.

jeff: PR opened: link https://git.redwood/repo/pull/842. Patch set ready for review.

alex: Thanks — we’ll reconvene if canary trips. :thumbsup:
